records.name: WC Mall Unirea
records.location: Unirea Shopping Centre at Piața Unirii 1, Bucharest. Official listed company filing 2026 confirms address; mall versus nearby metro WC are distinct. Saved point 44.427958,26.104713 plausible shopping centre.

activity.evidence: Original country index asks whether anyone nearby; no firsthand encounter.

records.physical_access: Colliers announced planned phased repositioning of Bucharest shopping complex (Splai wing then central zone then Călărași segment); this is a phased redevelopment plan, not proof of full shutdown. Specific toilet layout/access 2026 unverified. Store hours 10–22 are NOT restroom hours.
records.duplicates: Do not merge the shopping-centre toilet with metro Piata Unirii restrooms.
issues: Primary spot detail inaccessible; avoid claims that exact WC operates today
Future revisions should mention phased building redevelopment rather than generic 'may change' if current verified timeline is obtained

records.name: Pădure Dumbravita-Timisoara
records.location: Forest near Dumbrăvița at northeast edge of Timișoara. Official 2026 municipal file places Pădurea Verde adjacent to Dumbrăvița and Dumbrăvița reservoir, documenting 519.84-ha woodland. Same named place in original cruising lead not proven precise; general named forest location acceptable under owner's rule. Stored GPS blank, so broad map query could eventually be provided, not an invented exact pin.

activity.evidence: Country-index post offers immediate sexual activity, but reports no witnessed event.

records.physical_access: 2026 municipal forest project says existing paths are designated for pedestrians/cyclists and vehicles prohibited except administration/emergency. No need to guess remote entrance.
records.duplicates: Source identity not established with unique Pădurea Verde subarea; avoid merging the entire forest with another site by location alone.
issues: Improve address from 'unidentified forest' to plausible broad Pădurea Verde / Dumbrăvița context with explicit uncertainty
No coordinate should be invented for intimate site
No observed cruising evidence within time window

records.name: Weikerlsee
records.location: Weikerlsee is small bathing lake in Linz-Pichling, saved general site 48.2635,14.3612 plausible. Official Linz utilities and tourism distinguish *Kleiner Weikerlsee* from larger Weikerlsee. Official FKK/naturist area is on NORTH shore of the SMALLER lake, textile bathing to south. Larger lake is walking-only, NOT permitted for swimming.

activity.evidence: Country index named Joe_xy check-in; no eyewitness sexual activity.

records.physical_access: Ordinary public leisure lake, protected nature in vicinity; dedicated FKK sector does not mean consent to sexual activity.
records.duplicates: Two connected waters are separate lake basins, not automatically duplicate cruising listings; no source proof of particular cruising corner.
issues: Important physical-use distinction: larger lake walking-only; don't conflate with FKK bathing in small lake
Check whether saved general coordinate lands on small lake, without inventing specific cruising pin

records.name: WC Unionkreuzung
records.location: The City of Linz confirms Unionkreuzung public toilet on 'Untergeschoß Straßenbahn' (underground tram concourse) as the named facility, consistent with source's stop-level reference. Stored 48.29041,14.2973 is general stop location, no independent cubicle pinpoint.

activity.evidence: Original Austrian country index asks if someone is there right now.

records.physical_access: Linz municipality confirms 05:00–21:00, unattended WC, accessible and Euro-Key marked, no winter closure indicated; opening hours are ordinary toilet access, not cruising hours.
records.duplicates: Separate municipal WC from other tram-station toilets and nearby businesses; no proven duplicate.
issues: Specific municipal WC is verified: retain existing location and hours; avoid implying regular activity or same-day encounter from forum question
